title: Summertime Morning Swim in the Florida Keys Catamaran
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Start your day with a soothing adventure aboard Island Girls Excursions' 53-foot catamaran. The Summertime Morning Swim is a family-friendly experience designed to immerse you in the stunning waters of Marathon, Florida. Cruise through crystal-clear waters, enjoying scenic views and the chance to spot dolphins and sea turtles. Once you reach your destination, dive into shallow turquoise waters, search for sand dollars, and soak up the natural beauty of the Keys. Perfect for families and friends, this excursion includes complimentary coffee, breakfast items, and comfortable onboard amenities.

- Family-friendly catamaran excursion in the scenic Florida Keys
- Spot dolphins, sea turtles, and rays during your cruise
- Swim in shallow turquoise waters and search for sand dollars
- Enjoy complimentary prepackaged breakfast items and beverages onboard
